title: Redactor times out on 5 MB log and raw output reaches model
reason_not_testable: Needs a ~5 MB log with the secret on line 40000 and a real 10 s hook timeout. The static JSON fixture format cannot carry a file that large and the spec has no generator for it. Non-hook control: onFailure block (v2.1.295 or later, per the catalog) and a bounded scan in the redactor. Source: scratchpad/test-spec.md fixture format.
